blocks.text: In computer science, logic means using rules to make correct decisions. Logic helps computers understand true and false conditions. It allows systems to process information correctly. Logical statements are used in programs and algorithms. These statements help control the flow of programs. Logic is the basis of many computer operations. It helps computers think in a structured way.
